description:
Start a top-up. Returns a checkout_url that a HUMAN must open to pay; credit lands once payment settles, not when this returns. Never open the URL or attempt payment yourself. Confirm the amount with the user first.

Requires scope `billing:write`.

amount_usd.description: Amount to add, in US dollars.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for safe retries. Generated automatically when omitted. Reuse the SAME value when retrying the SAME logical request; never reuse it for a different one.

return_url.description: Where to send the customer after checkout.

name: create_topup
title: Add credit
